text:
kevin: FYI BlueNova just flagged two invoices for Dec (inv_202512_9002 and inv_202512_9002-copy). One shows compute charges doubled, the other has a tax line applied twice. Customer says amounts differ and they're blocked from approving payment.

ana: ugh. any PDFs/IDs? can you paste links?

kevin: PDFs: https://billing.redwood.app/invoices/inv_202512_9002.pdf and https://billing.redwood.app/invoices/inv_202512_9002-copy.pdf

ops-bot: invoice-generator run 2025-12-05T14:03:21Z completed with non-fatal errors. Job: https://ci.redwood.app/jobs/2025-12-05-9002. Warning code: 0x2F.

devin: quick glance of invoice_line table: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, description, amount_cents, tax_cents, source_event
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE invoice_id LIKE 'inv_202512_9002%'
ORDER BY invoice_id, id;
```

devin: result: inv_202512_9002 has compute @ $4,800.00 (should be $2,400.00) and tax_cents = 48000 (double), inv_202512_9002-copy has compute correct but tax applied twice as two separate tax lines.

maria: sounds like charge aggregation ran twice for the same usage batch while tax calculation hook also retried. Could be idempotency key mismatch between usage-collector and tax-service.

ana: did customer prepay? will double-charge hit their card immediately?

kevin: they haven't paid yet. they asked us to hold payment until corrected. support ticket: SUP-2337.

devin: mitigation plan: 1) pause electronic invoicing for BlueNova tenant, 2) run a dedupe/normalize pass to consolidate compute lines and collapse duplicate tax lines, 3) void the incorrect invoice and create corrected invoice + credit where needed, 4) follow up with customer note. I'll run step 2 in dry-run mode first.

ops-bot: created incident BILL-404 (billing pipeline: duplicate aggregation). Linked infra ticket INF-8123.

devin: dry-run diff (trimmed): ```diff
- invoice inv_202512_9002: compute $4800.00 (duplicated)
+ invoice inv_202512_9002-fixed: compute $2400.00
- invoice inv_202512_9002: tax line #1 $240.00
- invoice inv_202512_9002: tax line #2 $240.00
+ invoice inv_202512_9002-fixed: tax $240.00
```

maria: re-run reconciliation and ledger check before issuing any voids. last thing we want is leaving a customer with incorrect credit balance.

devin: ran reconciliation: pass. I generated corrected invoice inv_202512_9002-R and created credit cr_202512_0012 for the duplicate tax line. Ledger reference LEDG-202512-BN-12.

ana: please draft the customer-facing note explaining we discovered duplicate aggregation caused by a retry-race, that we've voided the incorrect invoice and issued a corrected one + credit memo. Also include assurance we're adding idempotency keys to tax-service calls.

kevin: copy for support: "We're sorry — we found a duplicate aggregation in your December invoice that temporarily inflated compute and tax charges. We've voided the incorrect invoice, issued a corrected invoice (inv_202512_9002-R) and a credit (cr_202512_0012). No payment has been processed. If you signed up for auto-pay, we've paused charges until you confirm."

maria: follow-up tasks: ENG-BILLING to add idempotency token to aggregation job (BILL-420), TAX team to enforce de-dup check (TAX-211), QA to add regression test for invoice reruns (QA-99).

de
ing: who owns the postmortem?

maria: I'll own the postmortem with devin and infra. Target: 72h. Adding notes to SUP-2337 and closing ticket once customer ACKs.

kevin: customer replied: "Thanks for quick action. Please send corrected invoice and confirmation when auto-pay is paused." Sara from support will ACK when sent.

ops-bot: job 2025-12-05-9002-retry completed successfully. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.app/artifacts/2025-12-05-9002-retry/diff.json

kevin: closing loop. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
